risks: Manufacturing always has challenges, but we’ve mitigated risk by: Building and thoroughly testing multiple prototypes across all seasons. Partnering with experienced, reliable suppliers. Designing for mechanical simplicity and reliability. Our biggest challenge is scale and logistics, and that’s exactly what this campaign supports us in overcoming.

faq.a: Scan the seed mat in the app, add it to the Harvester, top up the water, close the door — that's it. Home Harvest manages the light, water, airflow and timing for you.

faq.q: Do I need any gardening experience?
faq.a: No. Home Harvest is designed for people who want fresh food without needing any gardening knowledge. There's no soil, no mess, and no chemicals to add — just put the mat in, fill the water tank and go. The Harvester and App will handle the rest.

You can grow a huge range of fresh microgreens, herbs and salad leaves, with varieties such as basil, mint, radish, lettuce, pea shoots and sunflower shoots, as well as delicious salad mixes like Fields of Provence, all ready for your plate.

faq.q: How long does it take to harvest?
faq.a: Most crops are ready to harvest in around 10-15 days, depending on the variety, but some can be as quick as 8 days.

faq.q: How much food does one seed mat produce?
faq.a: One seed mat grows a full tray of fresh greens - which is about 5-6 bags of supermarket salad. The exact amount varies by crop, but it is designed to add fresh flavour, nutrition and texture to everyday meals, juices and smoothies.

No. You can buy what you need when you need it, but a subscription makes it easy to receive seed mats regularly, and you can pause or cancel at any time. For Kickstarter, we're offering different bundles of mats that will last you six months or all year.

faq.q: How much electricity does it use?
faq.a: Home Harvest is designed to be energy efficient. The smaller unit uses around a fifth of a typical fridge's energy, and the larger unit around half. In the UK this would cost around £2.50 a month to use, and in the US around $3.30 a month.

faq.q: Will it fit in my home?
faq.a: Yes. Home Harvest is designed to fit beautifully wherever it's placed, whether it's freestanding, on a kitchen worktop, or as an integrated unit, depending on the model. It's also made to be placed in colder areas of your home like a balcony or basement.
It is designed to be whisper-quiet and suitable for everyday home use. The lights are controlled to support growing without taking over your kitchen.

Remove the used seed mat, wipe down the tray and clean the water areas as directed. There's no soil or compost to deal with. There is also a self-clean mode which runs water through the system to get rid of any gunk.

faq.q: Are Home Harvest seeds genetically modified?
faq.a: No transgenic GM techniques are used in the breeding programmes of our seed supplier or its suppliers. Our seeds are supplied as non-GM to the best of the supplier's knowledge and belief. Alternative: No. All our seeds are non-GMO, grown by traditional breeding, with no seed treatments. Every pack can be traced back to its seed lot. Andrew, our co-founder, spent 20 years in commercial salad growing and picks every variety himself.

faq.q: Do I have to use your seed mats?
faq.a:
No. We wanted to make Home Harvest open source so you can use your own mats and seeds. We can't guarantee they will grow as well as ours though!

We have developed Home Harvest using a recycled paper mat and a natural starch, which keeps the seeds on. You can buy similar blank mats online and in stores. 

We've not tested it with any other types of mat, such as coir or coconut fibre. If you want to use a mat alternative that creates a lot of detritus, then this could get stuck in pipes and the p…

faq.q: Can you guarantee that seeds are completely GMO-free?
faq.a: No. Seeds are produced in open-field conditions, where pollen can circulate naturally. Although isolation measures are used to minimise the risk, it is not possible to guarantee the complete absence of trace, unintended GMO material.
Yes. All Home Harvest products are supplied pesticide-free and free from seed treatments.

Our seeds and growing products meet organic requirements under many standards and inspection bodies. However, organic rules, certification processes and permitted inputs vary between countries and certifying organisations. At this early stage of Home Harvest we do not yet hold an organic certification or type approval.

Our backers and the positive feedback for Home Harvest confirm the trust in our team, the project and our concept - finally a home growing product that’s affordable, reliable, fast and easy to use.
335 people have pledged £120,000 to bring Home Harvest to life, and Kickstarter has named us a Project We Love.
